% SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.11 shared normative core -- falsifiable predictions.
\section{Falsifiable predictions and limiting cases}
\label{sec:core-predictions}

Each prediction is an algebraic or semantic falsification target.  A future
conformance activity may choose an exact numerical tolerance justified by the
operation and representation before observing candidate output.  No result is
reported by this document.

\subsection{Analytic limits}

The following limits are required: a compatible donor pair with
$\phi_q=\phi_d$ gives unit raw donor scale; a replacement indicator tending
to zero gives identity; filter coefficients tending to a Kronecker delta give
identity; $M\to1$ gives no rate change; a source-mask radius tending to zero
selects only exact valid coincidences under the declared boundary; complete
context approaches the declared interior response; and a causal pole
approaching the unit circle exposes increasing memory and never retains a
stability claim at or outside the circle.
